landing.faq.1.a: No. Kit is clone-ready infrastructure — auth, RBAC, i18n, shell, backups, audit, offline, AI. Your finance, HR, and school modules live in your clone.
landing.faq.2.a: Product teams, agencies, NGOs, and builders who need a production MIS/ERP spine with multilingual UI, ops tools, and optional AI/offline.
landing.faq.3.a: Yes. App name, theme colors, shell layout, and locales are org settings. Keep the GS UI patterns; change the brand skin without forking CSS forever.
landing.faq.4.a: Both are opt-in via KIT_AI and KIT_OFFLINE. AI needs a model + API key under Settings → AI. Offline uses PWA + Dexie outbox with a sync API.
landing.faq.4.q: How do AI and offline work?
landing.faq.5.a: Open is the self-hosted core. Builder unlocks AI, offline, API/SMS foundations, and 12 months of kit upgrades. Organization adds onboarding, training, multi-clone license, and SLA.
landing.faq.6.a: Clone, copy .env, composer install, kit:install or migrate --seed, npm install && npm run build, then php artisan serve. Seeded admin: admin@example.com / password.
